title:
Switch Renderer for Edit Hyperparams Modal, used to display different components based on the hyperparameter type.

Return values:
- `string`: Renders `Reliability.EditStringHyperparamsForm`.
- `double`, `int`, `float`: Renders `Reliability.EditNumericHyperparamsForm`.
- `enum`, `boolean`: Renders `Reliability.EditEnumHyperparamsForm`.
- `json`, `map`, `pair`, `array`, `any`: Renders `Reliability.EditJsonHyperparamsContainer`.
name: EditHyperparamsSwitchRenderer
